$description: GENERATED by extraction/build_leakage_patterns.py from the real source - do not edit by hand (verify_all.py check [v] rebuilds and compares it whenever the source project is beside this package). Read by the GENERATION_MODE_* rules in schema/semantic_validate.py, which apply ONLY to mode=generation PageSpecs. Detection is string-based on normalised text and can be evaded by paraphrase; no human has reviewed these patterns.
normalisation: semantic_validate.normalise: Unicode NFKC, zero-width and soft-hyphen characters removed, curly single/double quotes folded to ' and ", every dash and minus sign folded to '-', lower-cased, whitespace collapsed.
shingleHash: sha256 of the space-joined normalised words, first 16 hex characters

GENERATION_MODE_CUSTOMER.rule: No real third-party customer or partner brand, and no customer/partner logo role.

GENERATION_MODE_URL.rule: No source host in any string, and any host name shown as text must use a reserved placeholder domain (.example or .invalid).

GENERATION_MODE_ASSET.rule: Only generation-safe asset roles; no asset path or string may reuse a real file name from public/assets.

GENERATION_MODE_PERSON.rule: No real-person photo role, and no 5-word run from the source's descriptions of real people.

GENERATION_MODE_SCREENSHOT.rule: No real product-imagery / screenshot role, and no 5-word run from the source's product-image descriptions.

GENERATION_MODE_COPY.rule: No 5-word run of the source's visible or accessible copy (any page), and no exact 3-4 word marketing line.

GENERATION_MODE_CLAIM.rule: No real award, registration, statistic or quantified product claim from the source, and no award-badge role.
